answer: The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a umber seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. The tide receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. A pre-written answer bank as a result goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 51 aliases trips the duplicate check at the canyon gate. Verification alone takes 9 days each. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
